title: Appellate Jurisdiction High Courts And Supreme Court Amendment Ordinance 1962

sections.shortTitle: Appellate Jurisdiction High Courts And Supreme Court Amendment Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE APPELLATE JURISDICTION (HIGH COURTS AND SUPREME COURT) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1962
THE APPELLATE
JURISDICTION (HIGH COURTS AND SUPREME COURT) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962.
[Approved by the National Assembly of Pakistan on the 7th
Dec., 1962, see Gaz. of P., 1962, Ext., p. 1547b-1547c.]
ORDINANCE No.
LXXIII of 1962
[18th August,
1962]
An Ordinance to amend
the Appellate Jurisdiction (High Courts and Supreme Court) Ordinance, 1962.
1.Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Appellate Jurisdiction
(High Courts and Supreme Court) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Appellate Jurisdiction High Courts And Supreme Court Amendment Ordinance 1962

Amendment of section 2, Ordinance L of 1962

THE APPELLATE JURISDICTION (HIGH COURTS AND SUPREME COURT) (AMENDMENT)

THE APPELLATE
JURISDICTION (HIGH COURTS AND SUPREME COURT) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962.
[Approved by the National Assembly of Pakistan on the 7th
Dec., 1962, see Gaz. of P., 1962, Ext., p. 1547b-1547c.]
ORDINANCE No.
LXXIII of 1962
[18th August,
1962]
An Ordinance to amend
the Appellate Jurisdiction (High Courts and Supreme Court) Ordinance, 1962.
2.Amendment of section 2,
Ordinance L of 1962. In the Appellate Jurisdiction (High Courts and Supreme
Am Court) Ordinance, 1962, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in
section 2, for the full stop at the end a colon shall be substituted and
thereafter the following proviso shall be added and shall be deemed always to
have been so added, namely:-
"Provided that any such
appeal pending before a High Court immediately before the commencement of this
Ordinance shall be continued in, and heard and disposed of by, such High Court
as if this Ordinance had not been promulgated.".

sections.shortTitle: Appellate Jurisdiction High Courts And Supreme Court Amendment Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Provision regarding appeals transferred to the Supreme Court

THE APPELLATE JURISDICTION (HIGH COURTS AND SUPREME COURT) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1962
THE APPELLATE
JURISDICTION (HIGH COURTS AND SUPREME COURT) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962.
[Approved by the National Assembly of Pakistan on the 7th
Dec., 1962, see Gaz. of P., 1962, Ext., p. 1547b-1547c.]
ORDINANCE No.
LXXIII of 1962
[18th August,
1962]
An Ordinance to amend
the Appellate Jurisdiction (High Courts and Supreme Court) Ordinance, 1962.
4.Provision regarding appeals
transferred to the Supreme Court. An appeal transferred to the Supreme
Court under section 3 of the said Ordinance,-
(i) if it has been decided and
disposed of by the Supreme Court before the commencement of this Ordinance,
shall, notwithstanding the amendment of the said Ordinance by this Ordinance,
be deemed to have been validly decided and disposed of, and
(ii) if it has not been so
decided and disposed of, shall be re-transferred to the High Court concerned
for hearing and disposal under the proviso to section 2 of the said Ordinance
as added by this Ordinance.
